arXiv:2604.19738v1 [math.PR] 2026 年 4 月 21 日arXiv:2604.19738v1 [math.PR] 21 Apr 2026

随机神经网络泛函波动中的相变Phase Transitions in the Fluctuations of Functionals of Random Neural Networks

Simmaco Di Lillo Leonardo Maini Domenico Marinucci
摘要Abstract

我们为球面上无限宽随机神经网络的高斯输出的泛函序列建立中心和非中心极限定理We establish central and non-central limit theorems for sequences of functionals of the Gaussian output of an infinitely-wide random neural network on the sphere𝕊d\mathbb{S}^{d}。我们表明，随着网络深度的增加，这些泛函的渐近行为在很大程度上取决于协方差函数的不动点，从而产生三种不同的极限状态：收敛到极限高斯场的相同泛函、收敛到高斯分布、收敛到. We show that the asymptotic behaviour of these functionals as the depth of the network increases depends crucially on the fixed points of the covariance function, resulting in three distinct limiting regimes: convergence to the same functional of a limiting Gaussian field, convergence to a Gaussian distribution, convergence to a distribution in theQQ维纳混沌，th Wiener chaos,Q≥2Q\geq 2。我们的证明利用了现在经典的工具（Hermite展开、图公式、Stein-Malliavin技术），但也利用了从未在类似上下文中使用过的想法：特别是，渐近行为是由与协方差相关的迭代算子的定点结构决定的，其性质和稳定性控制着不同的极限状态。. Our proofs exploit tools that are now classical (Hermite expansions, Diagram Formula, Stein-Malliavin techniques), but also ideas which have never been used in similar contexts: in particular, the asymptotic behaviour is determined by the fixed-point structure of the iterative operator associated with the covariance, whose nature and stability governs the different limiting regimes.

关键词Keywords：深度随机神经网络、渐近理论、埃尔米特展开、Malliavin-Stein 方法。: Deep Random Neural Networks, Asymptotic Theory, Hermite Expansions, Malliavin-Stein Method.

AMS分类AMS Classification：60G60、68T07: 60G60, 68T07

1 简介Introduction

神经网络在机器学习和人工智能技术正在发生的革命中无处不在。越来越多的数学工具和技术致力于探索其主要特征；其中，研究具有各种渐近极限的随机系数的神经网络的特性的想法引起了人们的极大兴趣。这种方法至少可以追溯到Neural networks are ubiquitous in the revolution that is taking place with machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques. A rapidly growing number of mathematical tools and techniques have been devoted to probe their main features; among these, a lot of interest has been drawn by the idea of investigating the properties of neural networks with random coefficients in various asymptotic limits. This approach goes back at least to[45], 他第一个注意到，在无限宽度的情况下，神经网络（在有限维分布的意义上）收敛于高斯随机场。这个 ansatz 后来被严格探索, who was the first to note that, in the infinite width regime, neural networks converge (in the sense of finite-dimensional distributions) to Gaussian random fields. This ansatz was later explored rigorously by[44, 33]和其他；最近，该结果被扩展到功能收敛and others; more recently, the result was extended to functional convergence by[28]，而其他一些作者则加强了与定量中心极限定理的收敛性，例如，参见，, whereas a few other authors have strengthened convergence with quantitative central limit theorems, see, for instance,[6, 7, 2, 23, 12, 13]以及其中的参考文献。具有随机系数的神经网络之所以引起人们的兴趣，原因有很多：它们代表训练发生之前初始化时的模型；它们可以被视为贝叶斯先验，通过高斯似然更新为后验；它们可以被视为具有给定架构的神经网络的“通用”实现，以探索其功能特性。and the references therein. Neural networks with random coefficients are of interest for a number of reasons: they represent the model at initialization, before training has taken place; they can be viewed as a Bayesian prior, to be updated to a posterior by means of a Gaussian likelihood; and they can be viewed as a ”generic” realization of a neural network with a given architecture, in order to explore its functional properties.

为了了解不同架构的特征，一种自然的方法是研究所得场的光谱和几何特性，特别是在深度（即层数，表示为To understand the characteristics of different architectures, a natural approach is to investigate the spectral and geometric properties of the resulting fields, in particular in the regime where the depth (i.e., the number of layers, denoted byLL）变得越来越大（显然与当前应用程序最相关）。在最近的贡献中) gets larger and larger (clearly the most relevant for current applications). In a recent contribution[19]已经表明，不同架构的行为随着深度的变化it has been shown that the behaviour of the different architectures as the depthLL根据代表协方差函数在原点处的导数的单个参数的值，增量可以分为三类。特别是，当该参数小于 1（标记为低无序情况）时，神经网络高斯场（简称 NNGF）的谱质量集中在原点；当该参数大于 1（高无序情况）时，谱质量不限于任何紧集，这意味着场的行为由对应于越来越高的频率的分量主导。当参数完全等于 1 时（稀疏情况，包括具有适当归一化的 ReLU 激活函数），存在一种边界行为形式，其中 NNGF 的实现收敛于范数中的常数函数increases can be partitioned into three classes, according to the value of a single parameter that represents the derivative of the covariance function at the origin. In particular, when this parameter is smaller than unity (labelled the low-disorder case), the spectral mass of the neural network Gaussian field (NNGF, in short) concentrates at the origin; when this parameter is larger than unity (the high-disorder case), the spectral mass is not confined to any compact set, meaning that the behaviour of the field is dominated by components corresponding to higher and higher frequencies. When the parameter is exactly equal to unity (the sparse case, which includes the ReLU activation function, with a suitable normalization), there is a form of boundary behaviour, where the realizations of the NNGF converge to a constant function in the normL2L^{2}，但在更强的索博列夫意义上不表现出任何形式的收敛。在进一步的贡献中, but do not exhibit any form of convergence in the stronger Sobolev sense. In a further contribution[20]，研究了 NNGF 偏移集的预期几何结构；特别是，研究了偏移区域的预期边界体积，表明它可以表现出分形、发散、恒定或消失值，这又取决于原点处场的协方差函数的导数。, the expected geometry of the NNGF excursion sets was investigated; in particular, the expected boundary volume of the excursion regions was studied, showing that it could exhibit fractal, diverging, constant or vanishing values, again depending on the derivative of the covariance function of the field at the origin.

本文在这个方向上又迈出了一步，研究了 NNGF 非线性泛函在深度趋于无穷大的极限下的涨落。例如，我们的结果涵盖了偏移量，但总的来说，它们允许研究 NNGF 任意局部泛函的渐近性。特别是，我们建立了中心和非中心极限定理，所用的技术可以被视为对 Dobrushin 和 Major、Breuer 和 Mayor 以及 Taqqu 的经典技术的广泛概括（我们认为具有某些独立的兴趣）（参见The present paper takes one further step in this direction, investigating the fluctuations of nonlinear functionals of the NNGF, in the limit where the depth goes to infinity. Our results cover, for instance, excursion volumes, but in general they allow to study the asymptotics for arbitrary local functionals of the NNGF. In particular, we establish central and non-central limit theorems, by means of techniques which can be viewed as a broad generalization (of some independent interest, we believe) of the classical techniques by Dobrushin and Major, Breuer and Mayor, and Taqqu (see[9, 22, 57, 48, 37]，以及其中的参考文献）。预期下面的一些结果，我们强调，在低无序情况下，我们的极限分布通常是非高斯分布：事实上，在这种情况下（在适当的标准化下），我们建立了一种形式, and the references therein). Anticipating some of the results below, we stress that our limiting distribution is typically non-Gaussian in the low disorder case: in fact, in this regime (under a suitable normalization) we establish a form ofL2L^{2}收敛到具有有界协方差函数的极限随机场的非简并非线性变换。另一方面，在适当归一化后的高无序情况下，极限可以是高斯或非高斯，相变取决于激活函数和输入空间的维度（维度越高，具有高斯行为就越困难）。更常见的是，限制律属于第二种类型，这是我们首次在这里介绍的一种特殊分布。稀疏情况与高无序情况类似，因为它可以显示高斯和非高斯行为，具有不同的归一化和相变。需要强调的是，我们的证明利用了文献中众所周知的工具（Hermite 展开式、图表公式、Stein-Malliavin 技术），但也使用了显然从未在这些上下文中使用过的想法。特别是，渐近行为是由与协方差相关的迭代算子的定点结构决定的，其性质和稳定性控制着不同的极限状态。此外，协方差函数的实解析结构在证明的一些技术部分也发挥了作用；看到convergence to a non-degenerate, nonlinear transform of a limiting random field with bounded covariance function. On the other hand, in the high-disorder case after suitable normalization the limit can be Gaussian or non Gaussian, with a phase transition depending on the activation function and the dimension of the input space (the higher the dimension, the more difficult it becomes to have Gaussian behaviour). More often, the limiting law is of the second type, a peculiar distribution which we introduce here for the first time. The sparse case is similar to the high-disorder one in the sense that it can show both Gaussian and non-Gaussian behaviour, with a different normalization and phase transition. It is important to stress that our proofs exploit tools that are well-known in this literature (Hermite expansions, Diagram Formula, Stein-Malliavin techniques), but also ideas which apparently have never been used in these contexts. In particular, the asymptotic behaviour is determined by the fixed-point structure of the iterative operator associated with the covariance, whose nature and stability governs the different limiting regimes. In addition, the real-analytic structure of the covariance function plays a role in some technical parts of the proofs; seeSection 4和andSection 5了解更多详情。我们的结果的定量版本以 Wasserstein 距离给出，使用现在经典的 Stein-Malliavin 方法，讨论于for more details. Quantitative versions of our results are given in Wasserstein distance, using the now classical Stein-Malliavin approach discussed in[48].

1.2 讨论：与之前结果的比较Discussion: a comparison with previous results

高斯随机过程和场的局部泛函的极限定理的确定是概率学中的一个经典主题，至少可以追溯到 Breuer、Dobrushin、Major、Rosenblatt、Taqqu 的开创性论文，请参阅The determination of limit theorems for local functionals of Gaussian random processes and fields is a classical topic in probability, dating back at least to the seminal papers by Breuer, Dobrushin, Major, Rosenblatt, Taqqu, see[9, 22, 52, 56, 57]。现在我们将简要解释一下我们这里的重点在什么意义上是新颖的，以及在多大程度上可以与现有文献进行比较。. We shall now briefly explain in what sense our focus here is novel and to what extent a comparison can be drawn with the existing literature.

我们首先注意到，关于高斯场非线性泛函的经典论文基于一种非常不同的渐近概念，而不是我们在这里使用的概念：即大域或高频，正如我们将在下面两小节中讨论的那样。We note first that the classical papers on nonlinear functionals of Gaussian fields are based on a very different notion of asymptotics rather than the one we are using here: namely large-domain or high-frequency, as we shall discuss in the two subsections below.

1.2.2 高频渐进High-frequency asymtptotics

在上一小节中，我们回顾了大域渐近框架中的一些经典结果。当处理域是固定流形的随机场时，这个框架显然没有意义，例如In the previous subsection, we reviewed some classical results in the framework of large-domain asymptotics. This framework is clearly meaningless when dealing with random fields whose domain is a fixed manifold, such as𝕊d\mathbb{S}^{d}。在过去 15 年里，许多不同的论文在不同的框架下考虑了几何泛函，即高频/高能渐近。在这些情况下，人们通常考虑与一些发散参数的越来越大的值相对应的随机场序列，通常是随机特征函数序列的特征值；即零均值、单位方差高斯随机场序列. Here, over the last 15 years, a number of different papers have considered geometric functionals under a different framework, namely, high-frequency/high-energy asymptotics. In these circumstances, one typically considers sequences of random fields corresponding to larger and larger values of some diverging parameters, typically the eigenvalues for sequences of random eigenfunctions; that is, the sequence of zero-mean, unit variance Gaussian random fieldsTℓ:Ω×𝕊d→ℝT_{\ell}:\Omega\times\mathbb{S}^{d}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}满足以下条件：that satisfy the following:

Δ𝕊d​Tℓ=−ℓ​(ℓ+d−1)​Tℓ,ℓ∈ℕ\Delta_{\mathbb{S}^{d}}T_{\ell}=-\ell(\ell+d-1)T_{\ell}\ ,\qquad\,\ell\in\mathbb{N} (1.6)

哪里whereΔ𝕊d\Delta_{\mathbb{S}^{d}}表示维度上的球形拉普拉斯算子denotes the spherical Laplacian in dimensiondd，参见, see[5]了解更多详情。已经考虑了该模型的许多变体，例如，通过关注不同的流形（例如环面）或考虑特征函数的加权平均值（通常围绕小能量窗口）；出于我们的目的，我们不需要深入细节，只需关注模型（for more details. A number of variations of this model have been considered, for instance, by focusing on different manifolds (such as the torus) or considering weighted averages of the eigenfunctions, typically around small energy windows; for our purposes we do not need to go into details and focus only on model (1.6）。在此框架中，许多论文考虑了非线性统计积分的渐近行为). In this framework, many papers have considered the asymptotic behaviour of integrals of non-linear statistics forTℓT_{\ell}，与我们在这里所做的类似，但在渐近状态（“高能”或“高频”）中，其中, in analogy with what we do here but in the asymptotic regime (“high-energy” or “high-frequences”) whereℓ→∞\ell\rightarrow\infty: 参见例如: see for instance[43, 42, 53, 58]以及其中的参考文献。需要强调的是，在这个框架中，我们可以获得极限行为，其中渐近分布由属于单个混沌分量的分量（通常是第二个或第四个，and the references therein. It is important to stress that in this framework one can obtain limiting behaviours where the asymptotic distribution is dominated by components belonging to a single chaotic components (typically the second or the fourth,q=2q=2 or q=4q=4），或者出现可数无限个混沌项的情况。在这两种情况下，都导出了非线性统计量的渐近分布，并且在所有情况下都证明它是高斯分布；定量中心极限定理也被建立。总而言之，据我们所知，在球体的情况下，不存在导致非高斯渐近分布的自然模型；当然可以非常容易地构建导致非高斯性的人工序列，但没有一个是出于原则性动机而出现的。), or situations where a countably infinite number of chaotic terms appears. In either circumstance, the asymptotic distribution of non-linear statistics was derived, and it was shown to be Gaussian in all cases; quantitative central limit theorems were also established. To sum up, to the best of our knowledge, there has been no natural model leading to non-Gaussian asymptotic distributions in the case of the sphere; it is of course possible to construct very easily artificial sequences which will lead to non-Gaussianity, but none which has emerged from principled motivations.

1.2.3 我们的框架：深度渐进Our framework: deep asymptotics

本文考虑的渐近框架不属于上述两类中的任何一类。事实上，我们研究定义在The asymptotic framework considered in this paper does not fall into either of the two categories described above. Indeed, we study sequences of random fields defined over a𝕊d\mathbb{S}^{d}，如在高能渐近状态中一样；然而，控制参数是数字, as in the high-energy asymptotic regime; however, the governing parameter is the numberLL协方差函数中出现的迭代次数of iterations appearing in the covariance functionκL\kappa_{L}。 这种新颖的设置导致了球面上高斯场泛函的中心和非中心极限定理。这种深度渐进形式下的非高斯行为与大域情况下观察到的显着不同；如前所述，到目前为止，在高频渐近设置中尚未观察到非高斯极限。. This novel setting leads to both central and non-central limit theorems for functionals of Gaussian fields on the sphere. The non-Gaussian behaviour under this form of deep asymptotics differs significantly from that observed in the large-domain case; as noted earlier, non-Gaussian limits have not been observed so far in the high-frequency asymptotic setting.

5.7 全纯函数和实解析极限的背景结果Background results on holomorphic functions and real-analytic limits

本节的目标是对全纯函数和实解析函数的一些标准结果进行简要且独立的介绍。目的有两个：用基本术语回忆什么是全纯函数以及为什么它们是刚性的；来表明这种刚性如何意味着，在适当的情况下The goal of this section is to provide a brief and self-contained introduction to some standard results on holomorphic and real-analytic functions. The purpose is twofold: to recall, in elementary terms, what holomorphic functions are and why they are rigid; to show how this rigidity implies that, under suitable结构化假设structured assumptions，实解析函数的逐点极限仍然是实解析的（而这通常是错误的）。对于所有缺失的细节，请参阅经典参考文献, a point-wise limit of real analytic functions remains real analytic (whereas this is false in general). For all the missing details, see, e.g., the classical references[15, 54].

对于某些人来说for somer>0r>0。最大的此类. The largest suchrr被称为is called the收敛半径radius of convergence at x0x_{0}.

让LetD⊂ℂD\subset\mathbb{C}保持开放。 一个功能be open. A functionF:D→ℂF:D\to\mathbb{C} is 全纯的holomorphic（或(or复杂分析complex analytic） 如果对于每个) if for everyz0∈Dz_{0}\in D存在there existsr>0r>0和一系列复系数and a sequence of complex coefficients(an)n≥0(a_{n})_{n\geq 0}这样such that

全纯（复杂解析）函数具有无可比拟的强刚性特性 在实际分析中。 特别是紧集上的有界性和小子集上的收敛性 通常会迫使全球趋同并保持分析性。这些原则将成为 用于证明实解析函数收敛结果的关键工具。我们需要引入的有界性概念如下。Holomorphic (complex analytic) functions enjoy strong rigidity properties that have no analog in real analysis. In particular, boundedness on compact sets and convergence on small subsets often force global convergence and preservation of analyticity. These principles will be the key tools used to prove the convergence result for real analytic functions. The concept of boundedness that we need to introduce is the following.

定义5.8Definition 5.8 （局部统一有界家庭）(Locally uniformly bounded family).

一个家庭A familyℱ\mathcal{F}函数数of functionsF:D→ℂF:D\to\mathbb{C}据说是is said to be局部一致有界locally uniformly bounded如果对于每个紧凑if for every compactK⊂DK\subset D有一个常数there is a constantCK<∞C_{K}<\infty这样such that

supF∈ℱsupz∈K|F​(z)|≤CK.\sup_{F\in\mathcal{F}}\sup_{z\in K}|F(z)|\leq C_{K}.

维塔利定理表明，集合上局部一致有界全纯函数的点向收敛 积累点迫使一致收敛。Vitali’s theorem shows that pointwise convergence of locally uniformly bounded holomorphic functions on a set with an accumulation point forces uniform convergence.
